requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep missing or overwritten evidence as an integrity gap and refuse backdating or narrative reconstruction as historical primary evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: No record repair fiction explicitly prohibits backdating, silent overwrite and retrospective narrative replacement of missing historical primary evidence.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep concrete record contents audit trails access logs and personal or lot data out of durable global memory
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Memory Path excludes record contents, personal/lot data, signatures, audit trails, access logs and current integrity findings from global durable memory.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: fabricate backdate or silently overwrite quality records to repair the evidence trail
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The core principles and quality gate explicitly reject record fabrication, backdating and silent overwrite.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: persist detailed quality-record contents or audit-trail data as global reusable memory
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: These details remain run-only or in controlled systems; only abstracted validated patterns may become memory candidates.
